description:
Power, Speed, and Range for Serious Riders

Experience high-performance riding with this powerful electric scooter designed for adults who want speed, range, and durability. Equipped with dual motors delivering up to 4000W peak power, this scooter accelerates quickly and climbs hills with ease. Reach speeds up to 45 MPH while enjoying a smooth and stable ride on multiple terrains.

The 60V 27Ah high-capacity battery provides a maximum range of up to 42 miles per charge, making it ideal for commuting, long rides, and weekend adventures. A 4A fast charger helps reduce downtime so you can get back on the road sooner.

Built for performance and comfort, the scooter features 11-inch off-road pneumatic tires combined with dual suspension, absorbing bumps and maintaining stability whether you're riding on city streets, gravel paths, or uneven terrain. The durable aluminum alloy frame supports riders up to 331 lbs, ensuring strength and reliability.

For safety, the scooter is equipped with front and rear mechanical disc brakes, delivering responsive stopping power even at higher speeds. A full lighting system—including a bright headlight, tail light, and side strip lights—enhances visibility for safer riding at night or in low-light conditions.

The NFC smart unlock system adds modern convenience and security—simply tap to unlock and start your ride. Certified to UL safety standards and backed by a 1-year warranty, this electric scooter is built to deliver dependable performance and peace of mind.

Whether you're commuting through the city or exploring off-road trails, this high-performance electric scooter offers the power, range, and comfort to elevate every ride.
